scope: Conditional research, not deployment: CSI raw peg matches dated rolling P/E factsheets but historical formula/revisions and first publication remain unverified
input: CSI 000300 and 000905 candidate rolling valuation from 2009-2026 public history, non-sessions excluded, positive valid readings only
availability: at least 1 trading session after quote, max 3 sessions stale beyond the declared information lag; stresses 2 and 5 sessions lag
history: Trailing 1260 market sessions before the known quote, at least 252 positive readings and >=95% valid readings since first positive observation within that window; current quote excluded from reference percentile
percentile: midpoint ties percentile of latest known reading separately for each index; mean of the two index percentiles for equity budget context

policies.value_confirmed_vol10: 50% if percentile <=20% and quality >0; 30% if percentile >=80% and quality <0; otherwise 40%
policies.value_hybrid_vol10: mean of valuation-proposed and quality-proposed equity budgets; unknown uses quality-proposed budget

risk_execution: Same 20% proposed gold, remainder bonds, per-bond 90% cap, past60 covariance 10% projected volatility constraint, 10session reviews, absolute3pp/relative25% bands
fees: normal buy/sell each 10bps scenario, under7 confirmation natural days at least150bps; confirmationT+1, settlementT+2, terminal redemptions included
fund_account_start: 120 past fund sessions; unknown early valuations do not exclude fund dates, passive fallback as declared
calendar: research-exchange-calendar-2009-2026-v2, corrected 2018-12-31 closure; old original retained and base-control impact independently replayed
validation: independent asof/percentile rebuild, ledger rebuild, past-return risk rebuild, archived row identity/hash checks; historical data already viewed, not untouched OOS
